name: Sandstone Beige Maheshwari
desc: A lightweight Maheshwari cotton-silk weave from the looms of Maheshwar on the Narmada, finished with a signature reversible zari border — equally elegant worn from either side.

name: Powder Blue Maheshwari Check
desc: Fine self-check Maheshwari cotton-silk, woven for everyday elegance with the distinctive Maheshwari stripe and a delicate gold-edged pallu.

name: Mustard Zari-Border Maheshwari
desc: Warm mustard Maheshwari silk with the traditional five-stripe pallu and a temple-inspired zari border, a design first woven for Rani Ahilyabai Holkar's court.

name: Indigo Block-Print Ajrakh
desc: Hand block-printed with natural indigo and madder dyes using the centuries-old Ajrakh resist-printing technique from Kutch — each geometric motif stamped by hand, no two lengths ever identical.

name: Madder Red Ajrakh Cotton
desc: Deep madder-red Ajrakh cotton, hand-printed in Ajrakhpur using wooden blocks and a multi-day natural dyeing process passed down through generations of the Khatri printing family.

name: Charcoal Geometric Ajrakh
desc: Ajrakh block-print in deep indigo-black, layered through repeated dye-and-print cycles for a rich, resist-dyed geometric pattern.

name: Wine Gold Paithani
desc: A pure silk Paithani from Paithan on the Godavari, hand-woven with a kaleidoscopic peacock motif pallu in real zari — traditionally taking a master weaver over a month to complete.

name: Peacock Purple Paithani
desc: Vibrant Paithani silk with the classic Asawali vine border and a hand-woven peacock pallu, a design once reserved for Maratha royalty.

name: Emerald Kamal Paithani
desc: Emerald Paithani silk with the traditional kamal (lotus) motif border, woven on a handloom using the tapestry (kadiyal) technique unique to Paithan.

name: Maroon Temple-Border Narayanpet
desc: Classic Narayanpet cotton-silk in deep maroon with a bold contrast temple border, woven in the handloom clusters of Narayanpet on the Telangana-Karnataka border.

name: Fuchsia Checks Narayanpet
desc: Narayanpet silk with a checked body and contrasting zari temple border, a design rooted in the town's centuries-old weaving tradition.

name: Ivory Contrast-Border Narayanpet
desc: Soft ivory Narayanpet cotton with a striking contrast border, woven for everyday grace with the region's signature temple-edge pattern.
